campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Ra-226, laboratory emanation g, porosity, saturation at sampling, dry bulk density: all published per site
campi_del_mandato.split: Field validation. No row enters calibration.
campi_del_mandato.units: Ra-226 Bq/kg; g dimensionless; porosity, saturation dimensionless; density kg/m3; flux Bq/m2/day

note: g is a laboratory value and the source does not state whether the sample was oven-dried. The dry/plateau reading used in the validation documents is a hypothesis, not a datum.
